requirements.text: Users sign in with GitHub and only ever see and change their own projects
A TypeScript/React/Next.js repo is indexed into files, components, exports, imports, routes and Supabase tables with RLS policies
Files are grouped into named features that the user can rename and correct
Agents can look up existing components by name, props and purpose before creating new ones
Code can be indexed on the user's machine so source code never leaves it
The Brain stays current: every push to the connected repo re-indexes the changed files
A new agent session starts with a handoff note: goal, last step, unfinished work, decisions, next step
Agents reach the Brain through one authenticated remote MCP server
Each user request becomes a checklist of testable items stored on its feature (living spec)
Each change gets a receipt: done/partly/missed per item, files by feature, out-of-scope edits, checks
New packages are verified (exists, age, repository link) before agents install them
Receipts flag exposed secrets in client code and Supabase tables without RLS or with allow-all policies
One command sets up Claude Code and Cursor (Skill, AGENTS.md section, MCP config, hooks)
A dashboard shows projects, features with status, and the receipts feed
Source code is never stored permanently on our side; only index metadata and short summaries
Users' standing preferences are remembered and given to every new agent session
Receipts say honestly what was not verified and flag weakened or deleted tests
Users can plan a new or existing project once: questions with defaults, then features with testable checklists in build order, approved by the user before agents build

features.title: Walking skeleton: pnpm monorepo, Next.js app, health endpoint, tests, local Postgres, CI green

acceptance.check: `pnpm install && pnpm -r build` succeeds on a fresh clone with workspaces apps/web (@brain/web), packages/core (@brain/core), packages/db (@brain/db), packages/cli (@brain/cli), packages/agent-kit (@brain/agent-kit)
GET /api/health returns 200 with {"ok":true,"db":true} when the database in DATABASE_URL is reachable
With DATABASE_URL pointing to an unreachable host, GET /api/health returns 503 with {"ok":false,"db":false} within 3 s
`pnpm test` runs Vitest with a verbose reporter so test names (including AC ids) are printed
`bash scripts/dev.sh` applies migrations and starts the app; http://localhost:3000 shows a placeholder home page
The GitHub Actions verify workflow passes on the skeleton commit

features.notes: Scaffold only. Package names as listed in AC-001-01. No Docker: development uses a Neon 'dev' branch (DATABASE_URL); tests use an in-process PGlite database through a shared test helper in @brain/db (no external DB needed locally or in CI). Add a `migrate` script in @brain/db (no tables yet).

features.title: Database schema, migrations and project-scoped repositories

acceptance.check: `pnpm --filter @brain/db migrate` creates all tables from docs/architecture.md (Data model) on an empty database
Running migrate twice in a row is a no-op and exits 0
Inserting a second file with the same (project_id, path) fails with a unique-constraint error
Every repository read/write function requires a projectId argument; a test calling a symbols query for project A returns zero rows of project B
Deleting a project cascades to its files, symbols, features, sessions, requests and receipts (test counts 0 rows left)

features.notes: Tables for better-auth are generated in FEAT-003; this feature owns the product tables. Repository tests run against PGlite via the @brain/db test helper.

features.title: Sign in with GitHub and private projects

acceptance.check: A user signs in with GitHub, creates a project named 'demo' and sees it in the project list
Signed-out requests to /api/projects/* return 401
User B requesting user A's project by id (GET /api/projects/<A-id>) gets 404, not 403 or 200
User B sending PATCH /api/projects/<A-id> with a new name gets 404 and the name is unchanged
Creating a project with an empty name or a name over 80 characters returns 400 with a field error
The user can create and revoke a project token; a revoked token is rejected (401) on the next request
Project tokens are stored only as hashes: the token value appears once in the create response and nowhere in the database

features.notes: Builds requireUser, requireProjectAccess and requireProjectToken (docs/architecture.md building blocks).

features.title: Code indexer: files, components, exports, imports and routes from TS/JS/TSX

acceptance.check: indexRepo(files) in @brain/core returns, for the fixture repo tests/fixtures/next-app, every React component with its name, props and file path
Next.js app-router routes (page.tsx, route.ts) are returned with their URL path, e.g. app/reviews/[id]/page.tsx -> /reviews/[id]
Each file's imports are resolved to repo paths (relative and @/ alias from tsconfig)
A file with a syntax error is reported in errors[] and does not stop the rest of the index
Files over 1 MB, binaries, node_modules, .next and files in .gitignore are skipped and listed as skipped
Indexing a generated 500-file fixture repo takes under 20 s on CI
The index output contains no source code: only paths, hashes, symbol names, signatures and line numbers

features.title: Supabase reader: tables and RLS policies from SQL migrations

acceptance.check: For tests/fixtures/supabase/migrations, every CREATE TABLE is returned with its columns
For each table, RLS enabled/disabled and each CREATE POLICY (command, roles, USING/WITH CHECK expression text) is returned
A table created in one migration and given RLS in a later migration is reported as RLS enabled
A migration file that fails to parse is reported in errors[] with its file name; other files are still read

features.title: Feature map: group files into named features and let the user correct them

acceptance.check: For the fixture app, files are grouped into features from routes and folders (e.g. 'reviews', 'auth', 'billing') with each file in exactly one primary feature
Shared files used by 3 or more features are marked shared instead of being forced into one feature
PATCH /api/projects/:id/features/:fid renames a feature and moving a file between features persists
Renaming a feature of another user's project returns 404
A feature name must be unique per project; a duplicate returns 409

features.title: Component registry and find_similar_component lookup

acceptance.check: After indexing, each component has a summary of at most 200 characters generated through llm.complete
findSimilarComponent('StarRatingInput') returns the existing 'StarRating' component as the top match for the fixture app
A query with no match above the similarity threshold returns an empty list, not the closest unrelated component
Summaries are generated only for new or changed components (hash changed); re-indexing an unchanged repo makes 0 LLM calls
findSimilarComponent answers in under 200 ms p95 for a project with 2,000 components

features.notes: Lexical similarity (name tokens, props, path) per D-005. Builds llm.complete in @brain/core.

features.title: CLI: projectbrain login + index (code is indexed locally, only metadata is uploaded)

acceptance.check: `projectbrain login` stores a project token in the user's config dir (not in the repo)
`projectbrain index` parses the repo locally with @brain/core and uploads files, symbols and routes in batches of at most 200 files
A test inspects every upload request body: it contains no source text from the fixture files (only paths, hashes, names, signatures)
POST /api/index with another project's token, or a token for project A posting to project B, returns 404 and stores nothing
An upload over 5 MB or with more than 200 files in one batch is rejected with 413
Re-running index uploads only files whose hash changed and prints 'N changed, M unchanged'

features.title: GitHub App: verified webhooks and incremental re-index on push

acceptance.check: Installing the GitHub App on a repo links it to the user's project (repo selection screen)
A push to the default branch triggers an Inngest job that re-indexes only the changed files
A webhook with a missing or wrong signature returns 401 and enqueues nothing
A replayed webhook delivery id is ignored (processed at most once)
After the job, no source code is stored: the job parses files in memory and saves only metadata
Re-indexing a push that changes 10 files completes in under 10 s (job duration logged)

features.title: Session continuity: decisions log, session log and where_did_we_stop

acceptance.check: save_progress stores goal, done, unfinished, next_step for a project; the newest entry is returned first
whereDidWeStop returns the last session, open checklist items, the 5 newest decisions and features in progress, in under 1,500 characters
Decisions can be added and listed per project with title, reason and date
save_progress with an empty goal or next_step returns 400
Reading another project's sessions or decisions returns 404
save_directive stores a user's standing instruction (e.g. 'no Docker'); whereDidWeStop always includes all active directives

features.title: Remote MCP server with authenticated tools

acceptance.check: An MCP client (Claude Code) connects to /mcp and lists the tools where_did_we_stop, get_context_pack, find_similar_component, save_progress, add_decision
Connecting without credentials, or with a revoked token, fails with 401
A token for project A calling any tool with project B's id returns a not-found error and no data
get_context_pack(feature) returns the feature's files, component summaries, decisions and rules, without source code
where_did_we_stop, get_context_pack and find_similar_component answer in under 500 ms p95 with 0 LLM calls
Tool calls with invalid arguments return a validation error naming the field

features.notes: Supports project tokens for v1; OAuth via better-auth for clients that require it.

acceptance.check: create_checklist(request) stores the request on its feature and splits it into 1-10 concrete items through llm.complete
For 'Add a pricing page with 3 plans and a monthly/yearly toggle' the checklist contains separate items for the page, the 3 plans and the toggle
An empty request or one over 4,000 characters returns 400
Ambiguous items are flagged needs_clarification=true instead of being guessed (fixture request 'make it better')
Creating a checklist on another user's project returns 404
Once created, checklist items cannot be reworded or deleted through MCP tools; a change is stored as a proposal and applies only after the user confirms it in the dashboard

features.title: Change receipt: done, partly, missed, files by feature, out-of-scope edits

acceptance.check: generate_receipt(changed files, checklist) returns per-item status done/partial/missed with file evidence
Changed files are grouped by feature; files outside the request's feature are listed under outside_scope
A change that touches the billing feature for a reviews request lists the billing file under outside_scope
Missed items stay open on the feature until marked done or dismissed; a later receipt can close them
A receipt with 0 changed files reports all items missed and makes no LLM call
A receipt for 20 changed files and 10 items is produced in under 15 s with at most 1 LLM call
Every receipt has a 'Not verified' section listing checklist items with no test or evidence, instead of calling them done
check_package('zod') reports exists, age, last release and repository link from the npm registry
check_package for a name that does not exist reports NOT FOUND and recommends not installing
A package first published fewer than 30 days ago, or with no repository link, is reported as risky
Names on the known-hallucinated list are flagged even if someone registered them
Receipts list every newly added dependency (diff of package.json) with its check_package result
A package version published fewer than 3 days ago is flagged (release cooldown) and an older version is suggested

features.title: Secret detector and RLS reviewer in receipts

acceptance.check: A Supabase service-role key or a secret API key in a client-side file is flagged with file and line
The Supabase anon key in client code is not flagged
Detected secret values are masked (first 4 characters + ***) in receipts, API responses, the database and logs (test greps all four)
Supabase tables with RLS disabled, or with a policy whose USING is 'true' for writes, are flagged in the receipt
A secret in .env.example with an empty value or a placeholder like 'your-key-here' is not flagged

features.title: One-command agent setup for Claude Code and Cursor

acceptance.check: `npx projectbrain init` detects Claude Code and Cursor, writes the MCP config for each and installs the Skill and an AGENTS.md section
The installed session-start hook calls where_did_we_stop and prints the handoff note at the start of a Claude Code session
The installed session-end hook calls save_progress and generate_receipt for the session's changed files
Running init twice does not duplicate config entries or AGENTS.md sections
init never overwrites an existing user section of AGENTS.md or existing hooks; it prints what it added
The session-end hook warns and lists open items when a session ends with checklist items neither done nor parked

features.title: Dashboard: projects, feature board and receipts feed

acceptance.check: The feature board lists features with status, file count, open items and last receipt date
The receipts feed shows ReceiptCards newest first with asked, done, missed, outside scope and checks
Every list has loading, empty (with one action), error and success states
Visiting another user's project dashboard URL returns the 404 page
The receipts feed loads 50 receipts in under 800 ms p95 and paginates beyond 50
'Send fix to agent' copies a prompt listing the missed items of a receipt

features.title: Test integrity check in receipts

acceptance.check: A diff that deletes a test file, or a test case, is flagged in the receipt with file and test name
Adding .skip/.only/xit, or removing expect() assertions from an existing test, is flagged
Changes to test config that exclude test files (e.g. vitest exclude/include) are flagged
Adding new tests or renaming a test without removing assertions is not flagged
A receipt reports the passing-test count before and after when the CLI or hook supplies test results, and flags any drop

features.notes: Idea adopted from the AI Build Kit's test-gaming guards; detection runs on the diff only (no source stored).

features.title: Project planning: plan_project tool and dashboard approval

acceptance.check: plan_project(idea) returns stage 1: the idea restated in at most 5 lines and at most 8 questions, each with a recommended default
After the answers (or 'approve defaults'), it returns a draft plan: features in build order with depends_on, each with 3-8 checklist items, saved as a draft that is not yet active
Every drafted feature has at least one negative, boundary, permission or attack item; a draft without one is regenerated or rejected before it is shown
Only the project owner can approve a draft, in the dashboard; MCP tools cannot approve or edit an approved plan (the agent cannot approve its own plan)
After approval, the features and their locked checklist items appear in the Brain, and where_did_we_stop names the next feature by build order
For an already indexed project, the draft marks features that already exist in the feature map as existing and plans only the missing ones
An empty idea or one over 8,000 characters returns 400; a second draft for the same project replaces the previous unapproved draft
Each planning stage uses at most 2 LLM calls and returns in under 30 s

features.notes: Light version of the AI Build Kit's kickoff. Full version (architecture/package comparison, design direction, threat models, re-planning) is in agent/later.md.
